# Odds Ace Australia

> Odds Ace Australia is a paid alert service for Australians who bet on US sports. It checks 7 Australian-licensed bookmakers (TAB, Sportsbet, Neds, PointsBet, Unibet, Betr and Betfair) against 8 major US sportsbooks 24 hours a day and sends a Telegram alert when an Aussie price is out of line with the US market, usually a gap of at least 12% (8% for unders) against the US reference price. Every alert is recorded at the price it went out at and settled from the box score once the game ends, wins and losses alike; the full record is public.

Key facts
- Website: https://oddsaceaustralia.com/ (Melbourne, Australia; sole trader Tony Chalhoub; ABN 38 722 496 289; registered business name Odds Ace Australia)
- Sports: NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and college basketball
- What an alert contains: the game, the market, the Aussie bookmaker and its price, the US reference price (bookmakers' margin removed) and the gap between them, e.g. Aussie 1.80 vs US reference price 1.65 = +9.1%
- Price: launch price A$79 a month (GST included) for members who join before 1 January 2027, kept for as long as the membership continues; standard price A$99 a month from 1 January 2027; 3-day free trial; cancel online at any time; payments through Whop
- Delivery: one private Telegram channel for members, with every alert
- After joining: a personal invite link to the channel arrives by email from info@oddsaceaustralia.com within 5 minutes (subject "Welcome to Odds Ace: your Telegram invite"), with step-by-step instructions for cancelling
- Public results: free Telegram channel https://t.me/oddsaceresults, and the results table on the website
- Not a tipping service: no predictions, no profit claims, no bookmaker affiliation or payments from bookmakers
- Independent: Odds Ace is a wagering-market analytics and information service, not a bookmaker. It doesn't accept or place bets, act for any bookmaker, or take commissions, referral fees or other payments from bookmakers; bookmaker prices are shown for comparison and analysis
- Australian residents aged 18 and over only. Gambling help: 1800 858 858, https://www.gamblinghelponline.org.au
- Contact: info@oddsaceaustralia.com

Pages
- [Home](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/): what it does, how it works, live figures (how many alerted prices beat the US closing price, the average closing value, how many had shortened by kick-off, settled alerts on the record), results table, pricing
- [FAQ](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#faq): how alerts work, joining the channel, the launch offer, cancelling and refunds
- [Why Australian odds on US sports lag the American market](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/why-aussie-odds-lag/): why Aussie prices move after the US market, what the gap means, how long an alerted price lasts
- [About](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#about): who runs it and why every result is published
- [Our method](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#method): how the US reference price is worked out (each US sportsbook's margin removed, then the median across at least 3 books on the same line; estimated where the US line differs from the Aussie one, and with an estimated margin on goal and touchdown scorer markets), the alert rules (a gap of at least 12%, or 8% for unders; 5% for game lines 60 to 30 minutes before the start if the US market has moved and the Aussie price hasn't; the Aussie price re-checked before sending; no new alerts in the final 10 minutes; gaps over 40% held back as likely market mismatches; at least 5 US books for games more than 3 days away) and what the numbers mean (the gap is the Aussie price divided by the US reference price, minus 1; a reference price is an estimate of the US market at that moment, not a prediction of the result, and any bet can lose)
- [After you join](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#after-you-join): what happens after checkout
- [Terms](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#terms), [Privacy](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#privacy), [Responsible gambling](https://oddsaceaustralia.com/#responsible-gambling)
- Quarterly results report, updated weekly (PDF and CSV): https://oddsaceaustralia.com/reports/latest.pdf and https://oddsaceaustralia.com/reports/latest.csv
